title: This sub gave some great feedback
author: Grox_are_shitty
selftext:
Last week I posted up my game: Boat! And a lot of you graciously took the time to provide a lot of good feedback. Ive spent the week implementing and changing things mostly based off what Ive heard here.

\- The biggest one is an online leaderboard. It is all routed through a backend on my personal website.

\- rebalancing difficulty, the game should now be easier to get going.

\- verticality of shot has been given visualization and tool tips. You also can not shoot through waves anymore.

\- ramming is now an upgradeable and legitimate Playstyle.

\- went with a slightly more painterly styled aesthetic. All shaders and textures modified.

\- wind plays a bigger role, although to keep an arcade feel, you can still sorta float into it.

\- sails are now a full cloth simulation, although they need more work.

\- major UI rework.

\- shallow waters are less stupid.

\- mobile and controller support.

\- canonball animations and timing have been made more realistic. Also smoke.

\- better instructions (I hope).

\- floating items pick up automatically.

\- ready to fire is more obvious.

\- distance measurements are all nautical now.

\- stand alone windows version.

I still have much work to do, but wanted to share this cumulative update as about 80% of the feedback came from this sub. More feedback always welcome. I posted my score to the leaderboard, I will be delighted if someone beats it!

https://nateharmsfpv.itch.io/boat

comments.author: MrTressy
comments.body: Not bad! Would love to see a remake of the classic Pirates!

comments.author: _theA_
comments.body:
Much better than the first version from the previous post, leadrboard also a nice addition. Tho upgrading to bigger ship after 3rd or 4th ship size upgrade(wargaleon feels very nice but then frigate not anymore) they start to feel not worth the size upgrade(they feel more like a sidegrade than an upgrade). There is also an issue of picking up stuff, slowing down to 4 is super hard when there is 4-5 enemy ships almost at all times trying to sink you, at some point its not worth to pick up anything (some ship upgrade that would allow to pick up items on the go would be nice). There is a chance that loot/part of the chart can spawn in safe zone and cant be picked up. That big ui rectangle in the bottom middle looks nice but blocks a lot of screen. Sometimes cashe does not spawn guards? I had that in two runs. Design issue/as intended, it more optimal to save upgades late game to have some heals on the sea when fighting(but i guess without it it would be hell to survive). Can't move map? only zoom in zoom out (at least with mouse).  
Overall very fun.

replies.author: Grox_are_shitty
replies.body:
Thanks for the extra feedback! I agree 100% on the big ships. Im still trying to figure out how to balance the big ones in a way that feels fair. Once you get all the way to the leviathan, you are basically doomed do die over a lack of maneuverability. Ill find a solution for this soon.

Thanks for letting me know about the spawn issue, Ill see about fixing that.

The idea to upgrade in order to pick up drops while moving is great! Ill work on adding a card for that as well.

Ill also add some random drops with health pickups to offset the feeling of needing to save your upgrade cards.
